response.sql: WITH order_net_rates AS (SELECT o.recordvault, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) as net_rate FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp JOIN fees f ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, u.acctscope), scope_stats AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) as scope_avg_net_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) as order_count FROM order_net_rates GROUP BY acctscope), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(scope_avg_net_rate) as plain_avg FROM scope_stats) SELECT s.acctscope, s.scope_avg_net_rate, s.order_count, s.scope_avg_net_rate - o.plain_avg as deviation FROM scope_stats s CROSS JOIN overall_average o ORDER BY s.acctscope

assumptions.assumption: Orders without at least one linked fee record are excluded (enforced by INNER JOIN on fees).

alternatives.interpretation: The 'plain average of the per-scope averages' could mean the scope-weighted overall average of all order net rates, rather than the unweighted mean of scope averages.
